policy: A question is listed only if a decision or a capture would change what is published. No answer is invented; 'unanswered' is a published state.

rows.question: May price data be captured at all, and from which source?
rows.why_it_blocks: Every price column, every ROI, every CLV value and every reward depends on it.
rows.what_would_answer_it: A named price source with terms that permit the use.

rows.question: May row-level nfl.com capture be committed to a public repository?
rows.why_it_blocks: Determines whether the availability layer is publishable or must be derived-only.
rows.what_would_answer_it: A reading of the site terms for the injury report and game books.

rows.question: Which clubs publish a structured depth chart?
rows.why_it_blocks: One club is captured and it is labelled unofficial; 31 are unknown.
rows.what_would_answer_it: One capture per club, 32 in total, each linked from its nfl.com roster page.

rows.question: Does an official snap-count source exist?
rows.why_it_blocks: Snap counts are the only route to a starter/backup split the brief will accept.
rows.what_would_answer_it: A published snap-count table on an official domain.

rows.question: What does 'Questionable' actually mean in play rate?
rows.why_it_blocks: The report gives no percentages, so any probability attached today is invented.
rows.what_would_answer_it: Several seasons of designations joined to official inactive lists, with intervals.

rows.question: How many clubs does the Week 10 report omit, and why?
rows.why_it_blocks: Four clubs have no section; three are Week 10 byes. TB is a Week 11 bye club that the report still omits while its peers appear.
rows.what_would_answer_it: A second dated capture, so omission can be distinguished from absence.

rows.question: Is a club-published 'Unofficial' depth chart acceptable as a source?
rows.why_it_blocks: The brief rejects inference; the club itself disclaims the chart.
rows.what_would_answer_it: An explicit acceptance or rejection with reasoning.

rows.question: Why does the standings page show NYG and WAS division records that do not sum to their games played?
rows.why_it_blocks: A published official field appears internally inconsistent; it is reproduced, not corrected.
rows.what_would_answer_it: The league's tie-breaking or standings definition page.

rows.question: Why does the Tampa Bay PF/PA pair look inverted against its record?
rows.why_it_blocks: TB is 3-6 with PF 202 and PA 178: a positive differential and a losing record. That is arithmetically possible, but it is worth a second dated read before any rating uses it.
rows.what_would_answer_it: A second capture on a later date.

rows.question: What is the out-of-sample window definition for demotion?
rows.why_it_blocks: The demotion gate is frozen as four graded weeks; the owner may want a different unit.

rows.question: Do the 12 Week 10 finals on the schedule page settle identically in the game books?
rows.why_it_blocks: Three game books were read of 12; the rest are single-sourced to the schedule page.

rows.question: Is the KC roster on this report consistent with the club's own roster page?
rows.why_it_blocks: The report lists players whose club affiliation differs from prior seasons; a second source is needed before any roster join.
rows.what_would_answer_it: The KC roster page captured on the same day.
